environment: fictional loopback form, response and accounts only; no real chapter data erased

tests.name: ordinary Admin cannot inspect permanent-deletion review
permanent deletion requires prior recoverable archive
review counts the actual original-version retained response
archive alone cannot bypass a live response's retention period
deletion counters expose no answer values or respondent email
eligible archived form receives a short-lived session-bound review
irreversible commit requires the current password
another valid session cannot use the review capability
stale form revision cannot pass deletion review
actual local HTTP commit permanently erases only the fictional reviewed form
a lost-response retry returns the same deletion result without repeated erasure
purged draft and immutable-version contents are concealed even from Super Admin
the former public respondent URL is unavailable
purged response history is not recoverable through review APIs
normal restore cannot resurrect permanently deleted content
actual database retains identifier/hash tombstones but no question definitions or answer values
one identifier-only permanent-deletion audit survives replay
